stories.title: 反科技情绪搬上大银幕：2026 年多部新片把矛头对准硅谷
stories.sourceTitle: The tech backlash is now in theaters
stories.summary: The Verge 报道称，虽然批判科技创始人的电影并不新鲜，但 2026 年这类影片异常密集，例如 Aaron Sorkin 的《The Social Reckoning》把马克·扎克伯格塑造成机器人式形象。这说明公众对硅谷重塑现实方式的质疑正在从舆论场蔓延到流行文化。
stories.analysis: 当反科技叙事成为院线题材，科技公司的公众形象压力就不再只来自监管和媒体，而是进入了更广泛的文化层面。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Though movies about disruptive tech founders are nothing new, 2026 has been unusually stacked with features that take a much more critical look at how Silicon Valley is reshaping our reality. Aaron Sorkin's The Social Reckoning frames Mark Zuckerberg as a robo

stories.title: 特朗普发 AI 修改过的白宫翻修对比照，被指存在多处不符
stories.sourceTitle: Trump posts AI-edited photo to brag about White House restoration work
stories.summary: 特朗普在 Truth Social 上发布了一组展示白宫翻修成果的照片，其中一张新旧柱子对比图疑似经过 AI 修改，存在多处细节不一致。这再次引发对政治人物使用 AI 生成或修饰图像的讨论。
stories.analysis: 当 AI 修图进入政治宣传场景，图像真实性的核验成本会迅速转移给公众和媒体。
stories.sourceExcerpt: President Donald Trump posted a series of photos on Truth Social showing off renovations to the White House - but one of them appears to be modified with AI. The picture, which compares an old White House column to a "restored" one, has several discrepancies a

stories.title: ChatGPT 的 Chrome 扩展升级，可以读取你已打开的浏览器标签页
stories.sourceTitle: ChatGPT can peek at your Chrome tabs now
stories.summary: OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Atlas 浏览器已下线，但 ChatGPT 的 Chrome 扩展获得升级：安装后，ChatGPT 在你提问时可以查看当前打开的浏览器标签页。这让 ChatGPT 更容易获取上下文，但也扩大了它接触用户浏览数据的范围。
stories.analysis: 从独立浏览器退回扩展形态，说明 OpenAI 选择用更低摩擦的方式切入用户的浏览上下文，同时把隐私权衡摆到了台面上。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI's ChatGPT Atlas browser is gone, but now ChatGPT's Google Chrome extension is getting some upgrades that allow it to use the browser tabs you already have open. With the extension installed, OpenAI says ChatGPT can now view your browser tabs when you ta

stories.title: 《全面战争：幕府将军 2》重制版首发翻车，世嘉将其下架停售
stories.sourceTitle: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale following disastrous launch
stories.summary: 由于首发表现糟糕，用户抱怨 bug 以及疑似由 AI 完成的画质放大，《全面战争：幕府将军 2 - Complete Edition》被世嘉从各商店下架。这款 2011 年策略游戏的重制版刚上线就遭遇口碑危机。
stories.analysis: 玩家对“AI 放大充数”的容忍度正在快速下降，重制作品一旦被发现偷工减料，商业代价可能直接是下架。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Sega is removing Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition from storefronts following a disastrous launch where users complained about issues like bugs and upscaling that appears to have been done by AI. Complete Edition, a remaster of the 2011 strategy game, lau

stories.title: Cal AI 靠网红大军走红：两年营收超 3000 万美元，被 MyFitnessPal 收购
stories.sourceTitle: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道称，Cal AI 两年内创造了超过 3000 万美元收入，并于今年 3 月被 MyFitnessPal 以未披露金额收购。小规模网红投放是其实现病毒式增长的关键。
stories.analysis: Cal AI 的路径说明，在 AI 应用同质化的当下，分发能力有时比模型能力更决定商业结果。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

stories.title: Bluesky 的 Attie AI 工具升级：可生成游戏和小应用，并以网站形式分享
stories.sourceTitle: Bluesky’s AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
stories.summary: Bluesky 的 Attie 最初用于通过 AI 构建自定义信息流，现在用户还能制作游戏、投票、仪表盘等“小型”社交应用，并作为独立网站分享给他人。这相当于把 vibe coding 直接接入了社交网络的分发渠道。
stories.analysis: 把生成能力与已有社交关系链绑定，Bluesky 试图用“做完就能传播”来差异化于纯开发工具。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Bluesky's Attie AI tool, which initially launched earlier this year as a way to use AI to build your own feeds, now lets you make "small" social apps like games, polls, and dashboards that you can then share with others as their own websites. In an interview a

stories.title: Windows 如何为 NVIDIA RTX Spark 笔记本做专门优化
stories.sourceTitle: How Windows is being optimized for Nvidia’s RTX Spark laptops
stories.summary: 微软与 NVIDIA 上周在旧金山为第一批 RTX Spark 笔记本举办发布会，新一代 AI PC 成为主角，现场设有体验区。The Verge 记者在媒体活动次日还参加了规模更小的 NVIDIA 交流活动。
stories.analysis: AI PC 的竞争正在从芯片参数转向系统级优化，微软与 NVIDIA 的配合深度将决定这类设备能否真正拉开体验差距。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Microsoft and Nvidia held a launch party for the first wave of RTX Spark laptops last week in San Francisco, where a new wave of AI PCs took center stage amid a packed crowd and a lively hands-on area. A day after the media event, I was invited to a quieter Nv

stories.title: 名人 AI 深度伪造防不胜防：一张假 Mia Goth 照片如何骗过众人
stories.sourceTitle: Nobody is safe from celebrity AI deepfakes
stories.summary: The Verge 以一张声称是女演员 Mia Goth 的 Instagram 图片为例——图中她穿着印有“MY EX IS MY BIGGEST FAN”字样的 T 恤，发布时间就在她提出离婚后不久。文章借此说明 AI 伪造内容如何借热点迅速扩散，名人乃至普通人都不安全。
stories.analysis: 深度伪造的杀伤力不只在于假，而在于它恰好出现在公众最愿意相信的时刻。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In hindsight, the post on Instagram should have raised more red flags. The image purported to show actress Mia Goth, just days after filing for divorce from actor and filmmaker Shia LaBeouf, posing in a T-shirt with a pointed message: MY EX IS MY BIGGEST FAN.

stories.title: OpenAI 推出 Rosalind Academic Plan，向学术实验室开放 GPT-Rosalind
stories.sourceTitle: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
stories.summary: OpenAI 宣布推出 Rosalind Academic Plan，符合条件的学术实验室可获得 GPT-Rosalind 的赞助访问权限及相关工具，用于推进生命科学研究。
stories.analysis: 把前沿模型以赞助形式送进学术实验室，既是人才与场景的提前布局，也可能让未来生命科学成果更深度绑定 OpenAI 生态。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and tools to advance life sciences research.

stories.title: Meta 与 Apple 合作，让 Muse AI 模型在 Mac 上跑得更顺
stories.sourceTitle: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
stories.summary: Meta 发布 Muse Spark Open，称其为“迄今最强的美国开放权重模型”，并表示它是同类中首个能在桌面端用两台 Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studio 运行的模型。这背后是 Meta 与 Apple 的联合优化。
stories.analysis: 开放权重模型开始把“能在家用桌面硬件上跑”作为卖点，Meta 与 Apple 的联手说明端侧部署正成为模型竞争的新战场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta announced the Muse Spark Open AI model today, claiming that it's the "most capable US open-weight model to date." But the company also says that it's the "the first model in its class" that can "run on your desktop using two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios wit

stories.title: Meta 发布可在 Mac 本地运行的开放权重模型 Muse Spark Open
stories.sourceTitle: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
stories.summary: Meta 与 Apple 合作推出 Muse Spark Open，该开放权重模型将在 Apple silicon 上本地运行。TechCrunch 认为这是两家公司在端侧 AI 方向的一次明确联手。
stories.analysis: 本地运行意味着数据不必上云，这对希望在企业或隐私敏感场景落地的开放权重模型来说是关键优势。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

stories.title: OpenAI 上线巴西葡萄牙语版 AI for Educators，用 Study Mode 支持提问式学习
stories.sourceTitle: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
stories.summary: 借教师节之际，OpenAI 推出巴西葡萄牙语的 AI for Educators，并展示 Study Mode 如何帮助教师引导学生进行主动、循序渐进的逐步学习。
stories.analysis: 教育是 AI 落地最敏感也最有价值的场景之一，OpenAI 选择用本地语言和教学模式切入，而非单纯卖通用能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Celebrate Teachers’ Day with AI for Educators in Brazilian Portuguese and see how Study Mode can help teachers support active, step-by-step learning.

stories.title: 亚马逊设备负责人 Panos Panay：未来 AI 设备会让 App 变得不再必要
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
stories.summary: 在 TechCrunch Disrupt 上，亚马逊设备负责人 Panos Panay 描绘了一个环境式 AI 设备的未来：设备在后台运行、预判用户需求，而不是等待用户下达命令。
stories.analysis: 如果 AI 设备真的转向主动预判，那么 App 作为入口的地位将被削弱，这对亚马逊这类既有硬件又有服务的公司是机会也是赌注。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.

stories.title: 别把身边人的数据喂给 AI 助手：Meta Muse 等个人助理引发隐私担忧
stories.sourceTitle: Friends don’t let friends feed their data to AI agents
stories.summary: The Verge 指出，消费电子领域正出现越来越多“监视周围一切”的设备，且往往不征求他人同意；随着 Meta Muse 这类 AI 个人助理出现，用户更容易把朋友和家人的数据交出去。
stories.analysis: 个人 AI 助理的便利建立在持续采集环境信息之上，而真正的隐私问题在于被记录的人从未同意。
stories.sourceExcerpt: There's a growing trend in the consumer tech world: gadgets designed to spy on everything and everyone around you, regardless of whether or not anyone else actually consented to it. Now, with the advent of "AI personal assistants" like Meta's Muse, you're bein

stories.title: Anthropic 给 METR 研究员员工级访问权限，并放弃阻止其发布评估的权利
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，METR 将自行发布对 Anthropic 风险、事故和做法的评估，而 Anthropic 放弃了阻止这些评估发布的权利，并向研究人员开放了员工级访问权限。
stories.analysis: 让外部机构独立评估且无权否决，在竞争激烈的前沿模型行业里是一种少见但可能形成示范的透明度做法。
stories.sourceExcerpt: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

stories.title: Bluesky 扩展 AI 平台 Attie：任何人都能做游戏、测验和网站
stories.sourceTitle: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
stories.summary: Bluesky 把“社交 vibe coding”带到实验性平台 Attie，用户可创建游戏、测验、网站等互动体验，并直接触达该社交网络的受众。
stories.analysis: 把创作工具与社交分发捆绑，Attie 实际上在测试一种“生成即发布”的新型内容生态。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.

stories.title: Benn Jordan 谈 Flock、隐私与新一轮反监控浪潮
stories.sourceTitle: Benn Jordan on Flock, privacy, and the new surveillance backlash
stories.summary: 音乐人、YouTuber 兼调查记者 Benn Jordan 在访谈中讨论 Flock 等监控系统带来的隐私问题，以及正在形成的新一轮公众反监控情绪。
stories.analysis: 监控技术的扩散速度已超过公众认知，反监控浪潮的兴起更像是社会对既成事实的迟来反应。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Today, I’m talking with Benn Jordan, musician, YouTuber, researcher, and investigative journalist. You might know Benn from those first two titles — he’s got a prolific discography of experimental music dating back decades. But in the last couple of years, he’

stories.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 早鸟优惠今日截止，通行证最高省 200 美元
stories.sourceTitle: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends October 16
stories.summary: TechCrunch Founder Summit 的 Founder 和 Investor 通行证优惠将于 10 月 16 日结束，最高可省 200 美元。活动将于 11 月 4 日在波士顿 SoWa Power Station 举行，预计有 1000 名创始人和投资人参加。
stories.analysis: 这类创投活动的票价窗口本身也是行业温度计，报名热度能反映当下创业融资的活跃程度。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit. These savings for Founder and Investor Passes vanish after Friday. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station. Bring your toughest questions and make the da

stories.title: AI Agent 将进入 Rivian 汽车，更多细节将在 12 月 AI & Autonomy Day 公布
stories.sourceTitle: AI agents are coming to Rivian’s cars
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，Rivian 计划把 AI Agent 引入其车辆，具体实现方式预计在公司 12 月举办的“AI & Autonomy Day”活动上进一步揭晓。
stories.analysis: 车企把 AI Agent 作为新卖点，意味着车内交互的竞争将从语音助手转向能主动执行任务的代理。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We'll likely learn more about how this will work at the company's upcoming "AI & Autonomy Day" event in December.

stories.title: Google 的 Universal Cart 购物工具在美国上线，接入搜索与 Gemini App
stories.sourceTitle: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
stories.summary: Google 新的购物工具 Universal Cart 已在美国面向 Google 搜索和 Gemini 应用的用户推出。
stories.analysis: 把购物车嵌进搜索与 Gemini，是 Google 把 AI 助手变现为交易入口的直接尝试。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 今日售票截止，通行证最高可省 75%
stories.sourceTitle: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Last day
stories.summary: TechCrunch 提醒今天是 Disrupt 2026 购票最后一天，通行证最高可享 75% 折扣。活动预计聚集 1 万多名科技从业者。
stories.analysis: 在 AI 投资热度高企的年份，这类大会的报名节奏往往能侧面反映从业者对行业前景的信心。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Last day to be part of TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Join 10,000+ tech leaders for a day of connections and insights. Save 75% on your pass now.

stories.title: 亚马逊旗下 Bee 发布两款个人 AI 设备，起售价 75 美元
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
stories.summary: 这是 Bee 被亚马逊收购后推出的首批新设备，包括一款升级版可穿戴设备和一张可吸附在手机上的信用卡大小录音器。设备可总结对话、生成待办事项，并与 Alexa 等集成。
stories.analysis: 把 AI 记录设备做到 75 美元价位，亚马逊显然想让“随身记录一切”变成大众消费习惯，但隐私争议也会随之放大。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and

stories.title: Sullivan & Cromwell 与 OpenAI 合作开发 Agreement Analyzer 合同审查工具
stories.sourceTitle: Sullivan & Cromwell brings legal expertise into agreement review
stories.summary: Sullivan & Cromwell 与 OpenAI 合作开发了 Agreement Analyzer，这是一款用于识别合同草案中问题的 AI 工具，把律所的法律专业能力带进了协议审阅环节。
stories.analysis: 头部律所亲自下场做垂直工具，说明 AI 在法律领域的落地正从通用助手走向深度嵌入专业流程。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In collaboration with OpenAI, Sullivan & Cromwell developed Agreement Analyzer, an AI tool for identifying issues in a draft agreement.

stories.title: SentinelOne 借 OpenAI Daybreak 把恶意软件分析从数周压缩到数小时
stories.sourceTitle: SentinelOne cuts malware analysis from weeks to hours
stories.summary: SentinelOne 使用 OpenAI Daybreak 后，将原本需要数周的恶意软件分析缩短到数小时，从而释放出更多产能去调查更多威胁。
stories.analysis: 安全运营的瓶颈长期在人力而非检测工具，AI 压缩分析耗时直接等于扩大了团队的威胁覆盖范围。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With OpenAI Daybreak, SentinelOne cuts weeks of malware analysis to hours, creating capacity to investigate more threats.

stories.title: Higgsfield 用 GPT-6 Astra 把 AI 视频从 1 分钟拉长到 10 分钟以上
stories.sourceTitle: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
stories.summary: Higgsfield 借助 GPT-6 Astra 让创作者生成超过 10 分钟的视频，用 GPT-Image-2.5 提升画面精度，并通过 GPT-Live 探索语音驱动的电影制作路径。
stories.analysis: AI 视频的竞争焦点正从单镜头质量转向长时长叙事能力，一旦突破 10 分钟，短片级创作流程将被重写。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Higgsfield brings creators longer videos with GPT-6 Astra, precise visuals with GPT-Image-2.5, and a path to voice filmmaking with GPT-Live.

stories.title: 黄仁勋谈中国 AI 公司：算力很缺，但他们就是在拼命把事情做成
stories.sourceTitle: 黄仁勋谈中国 AI 公司：算力很缺，但他们就是在拼命把事情做成
stories.summary: 黄仁勋在公开场合评价中国 AI 公司，称其面临严重的算力短缺，但依然在全力推进并把事情做成。这一表态折射出中国 AI 产业在资源约束下的执行力。
stories.analysis: 算力受限反而可能逼出更高效的工程路径和架构创新，这类外部评价值得作为观察中国 AI 竞争力的一条线索。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: MemSilicon 完成国际首款高密度大容量 1T4R 1Gb RRAM 芯片流片
stories.sourceTitle: MemSilicon完成国际首款高密度、大容量1T4R 1Gb RRAM芯片流片
stories.summary: MemSilicon 宣布完成其称为国际首款的高密度、大容量 1T4R 1Gb RRAM 芯片流片，该芯片采用与 CMOS 标准工艺兼容的 1TnR 技术路线，公司表示将加速后续研发。
stories.analysis: RRAM 若能在标准 CMOS 工艺上实现高密度大容量，存储与存算一体的路径会多一个现实选项。
stories.sourceExcerpt: CMOS标准工艺兼容的1TnR技术路线加速研发。

stories.title: Qwen3Guard 发布：Qwen 家族首个面向 Token 流的实时安全护栏模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen 团队推出 Qwen3Guard，这是 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 基础模型针对安全分类任务微调，可对接 token 流做实时安全判定。相关技术报告、GitHub 与 Hugging Face 资源已同步公开。
stories.analysis: 把安全模型做成可实时接入 token 流的独立组件，能让开发者在生成链路上直接加装合规闸门，而不必改动主模型。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tech Report GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope DISCORD Introduction We are excited to introduce Qwen3Guard, the first safety guardrail model in the Qwen family. Built upon the powerful Qwen3 foundation models and fine-tuned specifically for safety classificatoin,
